marta (runtime): Heads up — observed mem-growth + page-in spikes on longctx runs. suspect cross-request key reuse is causing big KV pages to get pinned and then thrash when eviction runs. attached a snippet from last prof run:

marta (runtime): ```
KVCache: hit_shared_fingerprint=4821 miss_unique=19324 pages_in=128 pages_out=312 reclaim_fail=12
heap_growth=+84MB over 10m longctx workload
```

sam (eng): Can you repro on staging with small load? do we have a correlation with request mix (many short prompts causing reuse)? :thinking:

marta (runtime): Repro is noisy but correlates with bursts of small requests that share a leading user prompt fragment. it looks like identical prefix fingerprints are being treated as identical for cross-session reuse even when contexts diverge later.

miguel (infra): That smells like our fingerprint key lacks a session epoch. current key: `tenant|model|prefix_hash`. proposal: add `session_epoch` and a 4-byte shield token to reduce accidental cross-session coalescing. e.g. `tenant|model|prefix_hash|epoch|shield`

lia (sre): If we add epoch+shield, eviction semantics change. we'll see more small-lived entries and less large-page residency — which is good — but need to tune TTL so small prefixes don't cause churn. Also need to ensure compaction isn't O(n) on rotation.

raj (ml): Could we instead canonicalize fingerprints to be age-bucketed? like append `age_bucket=round_down(now - first_seen, 5m)` so reuses within a 5m window stay, but older cross-tenant collisions are less likely. That avoids per-session state but gives time-bounded reuse.

sam (eng): tradeoffs: epoch+shield is exact but requires session lifecycle hooks. age-bucket is stateless but coarse. which causes fewer pages to be pinned? any profiling data?

marta (runtime): Quick experiment: ran 2h A/B on canary with age-bucket=5m. results: page_in rate down 18%, but miss rate up 12% and latency tail increased for some longctx sequences. still better overall memory profile.

miguel (infra): I can wire epoch into the session bootstrap with minimal overhead. also add a rotation TTL so epoch increments every 10m or on session reset. we should measure new metric: `kv_shared_shielded_reuse` vs `kv_shared_unshielded_reuse`.

raj (ml): I'll add instrumentation to eval harness to track reuse provenance. new counters: `reuse_by_tenant`, `reuse_by_session_epoch`, `reuse_by_prefix_len`. add a debug tag to entries so we can trace back which requests caused a shared fingerprint to be created.

lia (sre): operational checklist: 1) enable shielded key on canary pool only 2) keep canonical TTLs 3) monitor pages_in/out, reclaim_fail, and compaction latency 4) alert if reclaim_fail > 5 for 5m

dep-bot: canary deploy scheduled: runtime/kv-keying v2026.03.18-canary to pool:canary-3 at 2026-03-18T14:12:00Z

sam (eng): Action items: @miguel add epoch+shield to session proto and config flag (infra), @raj add provenance counters and a dashboard (ml), @marta run 6h longctx perf suite and post flamegraphs (runtime), @lia watch reclaim_fail and page-flip latency on canary (sre). aim to decide after 24h canary. :thumbsup:

marta (runtime): noted. I'll post first flamegraphs within 3h and include a tiny heap diff script in the thread.

sam (eng): thanks everyone — let's avoid global rollout until we see reclaim_fail drop and latency tail not regress.
